footer.key: Passwords are kept in the desktop's keyring (Secret Service), else unencrypted in ~/.config/omaflake/tokens.json. The default credential for new images is chosen in the Settings; a changed credential makes its images outdated.

intro.key: Who you are in a guest. NixOS images take the user (login, home folder, SSH), the full name and the e-mail (the account, git); a macOS base is created with the user, full name and password, and its images are built with them. The password is asked once, when you create the credential – after that omaflake uses it by itself. Every image and every macOS base is made with a credential; the default one unless you choose another.
